## Production Systems Shipped
- [amber Ocean](https://amberstudent.com): In-house Text-to-SQL AI harness powered by a central semantic layer, intelligent agentic query routing, and a custom MCP server over AWS Redshift. Eliminates 80%+ of ad-hoc SQL backlog across company departments.
- [amber Radar](https://amberstudent.com): Revenue-generating commercial B2B SaaS platform delivering predictive demand forecasting and dynamic competitive pricing models for global student housing operators. Built with Next.js, Scikit-Learn, and automated daily scrapers.
- [amber Prism](https://amberstudent.com): Communication transcript NLP engine providing 100% automated quality audit coverage across sales call transcripts and chats, with deal-risk alerts routed via n8n multi-channel webhooks.
- [plectrum.live & PlectrumLabs](https://plectrum.live): Music technology platform featuring 18+ in-browser audio ML tools running client-side ($0 server ML compute) plus 5 native C++17/JUCE 8 desktop DSP audio plugins (PluckMaster 7-stage DSP, PluckBoard pitch visualizer, PluckStem stem separator, PluckNote pitch-to-MIDI).
- [5X Data Platform](https://5x.co): Enterprise data platform engineering including usage-based billing microservices, identity access management (IAM), and custom Streamlit data applications.
- [Junglee Games Analytics Suite](https://jungleegames.com): Real-money gaming GTM onboarding funnels, goal-based reward microservices (+20% reactivation), and automated fraud/double-spend telemetry.
- [Turing Enterprise AI / RLHF](https://turing.com): Multimodal evaluations for the MMMU benchmark, AI-vs-human content detection classifiers, and automated feedback categorization.
- [Crimson AI / Trinka AI](https://trinka.ai): Academic writing assistant performance optimization (-40% Word Add-in load latency) and Amplitude analytics.
- [HISP India COVID-19 Surveillance](https://hispindia.org): Public health spatial data infrastructure, healthcare resource geo-tagging, and query deduplication (+25% efficiency).
